identity.name: Porcelain Lung
identity.summary: A cream ceramic lung with thick blue branching channels.
identity.description: Adds 2 maximum mana, refreshed each round. Removes up to 3 poison before its round tick. Supplies 2 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.
identity.lore: Its maker needed a place to store a last clean breath.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Bottle of Yesterday, Mercy Needlecase, Pearl of Brine, Wax Ear Trumpet into Porcelain Lung.
